description: Singapore government open data: NEA weather and air quality, PUB flood alerts, carparks, cameras, public holidays and hawker closures from data.gov.sg, and bus, MRT and traffic from LTA DataMall.

agents.description: Answer Singapore weather, rain, haze/PSI, UV and heat questions; flood and lightning alerts; carpark lots and free or night parking; speed and red-light cameras; public holidays; and hawker centre closures. Brief it with the owner's region (north, south, east, west or central) and any saved carpark codes or favourite hawker centres when relevant.

Live Singapore bus arrivals at a stop, bus stop lookup by name or road, MRT/LRT service status and disruptions, and traffic incidents. Brief it with the owner's saved bus stop codes and services when relevant.
